name: Breadcrumbs
description: Shows where the current page sits in the hierarchy: a trail of links ending in the current page. Compose it from item children, or pass the same levels as items. Long trails collapse their middle behind an overflow button that reveals it.

livewire.name: breadcrumbs
capabilities: Children: breadcrumbs-item; 2.x link children in the slot still render as levels
navigate adds wire:navigate to every link
Items also accept the 2.x link key for href

react.name: Breadcrumbs
capabilities: An item's renderLink renders a router link (Inertia, React Router) instead of the anchor

vue.name: Breadcrumbs
capabilities: The scoped link slot renders a router link instead of the anchor

props.name: items
props.description: The trail as data, from the section down to the current page: { label, href, icon, hideLabel }. Item children follow it, and the last level is the current page, never a link. icon is a registry name shown before the label; hideLabel keeps the label for screen readers only (a home icon).

props.name: maxItems
props.description: How many entries show before the middle collapses: the first item, an overflow button and the last maxItems - 2 items. The overflow button reveals the hidden levels in place. 0 never collapses.

props.name: label
props.description: The navigation landmark's accessible name. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Breadcrumb' ).
props.a11y: Names the nav landmark, so it is distinct from the main navigation.

props.name: overflowLabel
props.description: The overflow button's accessible name; {count} is the number of hidden levels. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Show {count} more levels' ).

props.name: navigate
props.description: Adds wire:navigate to every internal link, so Livewire swaps the page in without a full reload. Off-site, `#` and `mailto:` links load normally.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { link: '…', current: '…' }.

parts.name: item
parts.description: One level: a separator (after the first), then a link, the overflow button or the current page.

parts.name: link
parts.description: A level above the current page.

parts.name: separator
parts.description: The chevron between levels. Hidden from assistive technology; mirrors in RTL.

parts.name: current
parts.description: The current page, with aria-current="page". Not a link.

parts.name: overflow
parts.description: Stands in for the collapsed middle levels and reveals them.

keyboard.action: Moves through the links and the overflow button. The current page isn't a stop.
On the overflow button, reveals the hidden levels and moves focus to the first of them.

requirements: A nav landmark named by label ("Breadcrumb"), holding an ordered list.
The current page has aria-current="page" and isn't a link.
Separators are aria-hidden and mirror in RTL.
The overflow button names how many levels it hides and sets aria-expanded; revealed levels follow it in the reading order.
Links keep 4.5:1 (--apui-text-muted) and show a visible focus ring.
